$comment: OPTIONAL overrides — you usually do NOT need this file. The poller auto-discovers every mod from the catalog (CATALOG_REPO) by reading each mod.json, so a modder just publishes to the catalog and notifications work with zero server config. Copy to mods.config.json ONLY for edge cases: (a) track a mod that isn't in the catalog, or (b) force a different value than the catalog declares. Entries merge ON TOP of the catalog by 'id'. Fields: 'updateMechanism' = 'WolPatcher' (reads 'updateInfoUrl' XML) | 'GitHubReleases' (reads 'githubRepo' releases); 'translationsRepo' = owner/repo of the translations releases.
